js: (()=>{const T=__dbg.THREE;const c=new T.Vector3(2.6,12.87,1.6);const R=__dbg.cloud.userData.radii||[8.5,4.6,6.4];const rad=[8.5,4.6,6.4];const dir=new T.Vector3(1,0.12,0.75).normalize();let t=1/Math.sqrt((dir.x/rad[0])**2+(dir.y/rad[1])**2+(dir.z/rad[2])**2);const p=c.clone().addScaledVector(dir,t);window.__sp=p;const L=__dbg.cloud.userData.puffs;const out={};[2,3,4,5,6,7,8].forEach(R2=>{let n=0;L.forEach(it=>{if(it.home.distanceTo(p)<=R2)n++;});out['R'+R2]=n;});const rn={};L.forEach(it=>{const k=Math.round(it.rN*10)/10;rn[k]=(rn[k]||0)+1;});return JSON.stringify({surfaceT:+t.toFixed(2),point:[p.x.toFixed(2),p.y.toFixed(2),p.z.toFixed(2)].join(','),counts:out,rNhist:rn});})()
